newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT-Nestle, Heineken on Lehman list.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Nestle, Heineken on Lehman list.

text.p: Swiss foods group Nestle SA and Dutch brewer Heineken NV were added to the "European recommended list" at Lehman Brothers, the investment bank said on Tuesday.
The two replaced German tyre maker Continental AG and carmaker BMW AG on the Lehman list.
In a note on investment strategy, Lehman said European cyclical stocks had outperformed since their low point at the end of October last year and it was time to take profits.

"We do not anticipate a period of pronounced underperformance but it does leave us feeling somewhat nervous about those internationally-oriented cyclicals that have performed so well in recent months," Lehman strategists said.
They said Nestle and Heineken had both suffered disproportionately during a recent flight away from defensive stocks, while Continental and BMW were either at or near their price targets.
